character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
An elderly Korean man in his seventies who serves as the village head in a 1990s rural village. He has neatly combed short white hair with a slightly receding hairline, thick white eyebrows, deep wrinkles, and a stern grumpy expression that still feels dependable. His posture is slightly bent with age.

He wears a faded white long-sleeved shirt with rolled sleeves, a dark forest-green buttoned vest, loose dark brown trousers, and worn black slip-on shoes. Short elderly proportions with slightly narrow shoulders, a round head, and a clear recognizable silhouette.

Cozy Korean countryside mystery game character, muted natural colors, simple low-detail pixel art, restrained two-step shading, subtle dark-brown selective outlines, low top-down camera view.

No hat, no cane, no weapon, no item in hands, no modern accessories, no text, plain transparent background.
